statement.p: Consider the function \displaystyle{ f(x) = {\frac{x^{2}-1}{x^{2}+5x-6}} } . Complete the table with the appropriate values for f(x). Round to five decimal places where needed.

hint.p: Plug each x value into the function \displaystyle{ f(x) = {\frac{x^{2}-1}{x^{2}+5x-6}} }. It might be easier to factor and simplify first but it is not necessary.

statement.p: Your results from the table indicate the two-sided limit of \displaystyle{ \lim_{x \to 1} \left({\frac{x^{2}-1}{x^{2}+5x-6}}\right)} is (if the two-sided limit does not exist, type in DNE).

hint.p: Recall, the two sided limit exists if and only if both one sided limits exist and are equal. In other words,
\displaystyle{\lim_{x\rightarrow a} f(x)} exists and is equal to L if and only if \displaystyle{\lim_{x\rightarrow a^+} f(x)=\lim_{x\rightarrow a^-} f(x) = L}
